hostname.description: Public hostname or FQDN of this Icecast server (used in URLs and YP directory).

ports.description: Ports for HTTP and optional HTTPS connections.

http.description: HTTP port for stream delivery and admin interface.

https.description: HTTPS port (if SSL is enabled). Set to `null` to disable.

paths.description: File system paths for web assets and SSL.

webroot.description: Directory containing static web content (HTML/JS) for client interfaces.

adminroot.description: Directory containing admin UI assets (templates, images).

ssl_certificate.description: Path to SSL certificate file (PEM format, required for HTTPS).

ssl_certificate_key.description: Path to SSL private key file (PEM format, unencrypted).

ssl_ca_list.description: Optional path to CA bundle for client certificate verification.

accesslog.description: File path for client access logs (each connection).

errorlog.description: File path for error and status logs.

logsize.description: Maximum log file size in bytes before rotation (0 = no rotation).

logjson.description: Output logs in JSON format (requires Icecast ≥2.5.0).

auth.description: Credentials for source, relay, and admin access.

password.description: Password for source clients. Use a strong password in production!

username.description: Username for relay connections to upstream servers.
Username for the Icecast admin web interface.

password.description: Password for the admin interface. Change in production!

relays.description: List of upstream servers to relay (pull streams from). Each item defines a relay mount.

server.description: Hostname or IP of upstream server.

local_mount.description: Local mount path where relayed stream will appear (e.g., '/relayed').

password.description: Relay password (must match upstream relay credentials).

on_demand.description: Start relay only when a client connects (saves bandwidth).

shoutcast_metadata.description: Attempt to parse SHOUTcast metadata (for legacy compatibility).

timeout.description: Connection timeout in seconds (0 = use default).

mounts.description: List of static mount points with custom settings (max listeners, fallback, etc.).

username.description: Optional username override for this mount (instead of global source user).

password.description: Optional password override for this mount. If omitted, global source credentials apply.

fallback_mount.description: Local mount to stream when this one disconnects (e.g., '/fallback').

fallback_location.description: External URL to redirect clients when stream is offline.

listener_timeout.description: Idle timeout in seconds before disconnecting inactive listeners.

genre.description: Stream genre (e.g., 'Rock', 'Jazz') — visible in YP directory.

public.description: Whether to list this stream in public YP (Yellow Pages) directory.

description.description: Stream description — visible to clients and YP.

bitrate.description: Bitrate in kbps — used for YP display (optional).

burst_on_connect.description: Enable burst-on-connect (send buffered data immediately to new clients).

burst_size.description: Max bytes to burst per client on connect (0 = disable burst).

client_timeout.description: Client idle timeout in seconds (after which client is dropped).

source_ip_limit.description: Max concurrent source connections per IP (prevents abuse).

client_ip_limit.description: Max concurrent client connections per IP.

burst_limit.description: Total burst bytes allowed per IP (DDoS mitigation).
